ratings.label: Preferred
ratings.shortDefinition: Recommended first-line or acceptable primary therapy in the relevant context.

ratings.label: Alternative
ratings.shortDefinition: Potentially effective alternative, but less favourable than preferred options.

ratings.label: Limited utility
ratings.shortDefinition: Usefulness depends on infection type, resistance, combination therapy, or other important limitations.

ratings.label: Not recommended
ratings.shortDefinition: Not ordinarily recommended because of effectiveness, resistance, penetration, safety, or limited evidence.

ratings.label: Insufficient data
ratings.shortDefinition: Not enough evidence to recommend use.

interpretationNotes: Ratings describe general usefulness and may not apply to every syndrome.
Regional resistance patterns and patient-specific factors can change suitability.
The five codes are categorical; they should not be treated as quantitative susceptibility probabilities.
